reply: {"action":"run_code","code":"const counts = new Map<string, number>(); let page = 1; const pages = []; while (page) { const result = await tools.list_issues({repo:'acme/api',state:'open',page}); pages.push([page,result.items.length,result.next_page]); for (const issue of result.items) { const title = issue.milestone?.title; if (title != null) counts.set(title, (counts.get(title) ?? 0) + 1); } page = result.next_page; } return { pages, ranking: [...counts].sort(([titleA,countA],[titleB,countB]) => countB-countA || titleA.localeCompare(titleB,'en')) };","answer":""}
